who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane allows (V14) under proofs-1113
what: blaze_auto failed with `Failed to construct rule SpecProof.global ...eq_1` and `failed to synthesize Std.WP.Assertion Prop` because the file had only `open Blaze`; it needs `open Blaze Std.WP Lean.Order` (scoped instances) like Busy.lean and Clock.lean. The message names neither the missing open nor the scope.
cost: one build round and some misdirected debugging
cause: the instances vcgen needs are scoped to Std.WP / Lean.Order, and blaze_auto does not open them itself
whys: blaze_auto expands to vcgen inside the caller scope; the caller scope decides which scoped instances exist; nothing checks that before vcgen runs
class: a tactic whose correctness depends on the caller opening namespaces (hidden precondition)
prevention: make blaze_auto open Std.WP and Lean.Order in its own expansion (`open Std.WP Lean.Order in vcgen ...`), so no proof file has to
workaround: start every proof file with `open Blaze Std.WP Lean.Order`
